interpretation: BR-H compares4x4 versus2x2 averaging at same phase,density,support and query reconstruction.
DBR-DR compares4x4 versus2x2 averages on same coarse grid.
DR-H and DBR-BR combine sampling density and reconstruction; these operations are not individually separated.
H-R is not pure phase: it includes half-grid averaging,resampling and changed support.
Matched factorial interaction is a loss contrast, not a module responsibility percentage.
